find.question: How does Baise help me find a trusted service provider?
find.answer: Baise brings provider profiles, reviews, service details, and payment confidence into one place so you can compare before you book.

providerGrowth.question: Can service providers use Baise to grow their business?
providerGrowth.answer: Yes. Providers can use Baise to get found, show their work, collect reviews, send invoices, accept payments, and keep client records organized.

paymentPlans.question: Can providers offer recurring or milestone payments?
paymentPlans.answer: Yes. Providers can support one-off payments, subscriptions, weekly or monthly services, payment schedules, and benchmark-based payment releases.

account.question: Do I need an account to access provider tools?
account.answer: Yes. Provider dashboards, payment tools, invoices, records, and business management features require account creation and sign in.

clientRecords.question: Can clients keep receipts and service history?
clientRecords.answer: Yes. Clients can keep receipts, invoices, payment proof, provider history, and service records inside their account.

services.question: What types of services does Baise support?
services.answer: Baise connects people with trusted professionals across home services, medical services, and legal services through Casa, Medical, and Legal Baise.

pilot.heroAlt: Pilot tester programme — 60 days of full professional access.
pilot.benefit1Body: A professional account with everything unlocked: listings, quotes, invoices, subcontractors and team seats.
pilot.benefit2Body: You negotiate, hire and invoice with the other testers — not with empty screens.
pilot.benefit3Body: Whatever you find gets fixed before launch. That is the whole point of the pilot.
pilot.termsLede: Read these carefully. Ticking the boxes below accepts them — there is no separate contract to sign afterwards.

terms.1: Your test account is invisible to the public. It is marked [TESTE] and only other testers can see it — no real customer will find you.
terms.2: No real money moves. No payment method is connected. Any invoice, balance or payout you see is simulated.
terms.3: Use fictitious data only. Do not enter information about any real person — no clients, no patients, no legal matters, and no real CPF, CNPJ or bank details.
terms.4: The software is pre-release and provided "as is". It will contain defects. Do not use it for real work and do not rely on it as a record.
terms.5: After 60 days your account is deactivated and the test content is removed. Nothing is kept for you.
terms.6: Confidentiality: you will see unreleased features and screens. Do not publish or share them until we release them.

pilot.formLede: It takes under two minutes. We review every application individually.
pilot.fieldRole: How do you want to take part?
pilot.fieldMotivation: Why do you want to take part?
pilot.fieldMotivationPlaceholder: A sentence or two is plenty.
pilot.roleClient: Client — I want to hire services
pilot.consentTerms: I have read and accept the pilot rules above. I understand this is test software, that I will use fictitious data only, and that no real payment takes place.
pilot.consentLgpd: I authorise the use of my contact details to assess my application and to talk to me about the pilot. I can withdraw this at any time.
pilot.signNote: By submitting you accept the terms above. We keep the date, the version of the terms and your signature as the record.

signature.label: Sign with your finger or mouse
signature.hint: Optional — sign with your finger or mouse.

pilot.successBody: We will review the applications and get in touch at the email you gave us. If you are selected we will send you your individual access code.

faq.a1: No. The 60 days of full professional access are free. We never ask for a card and you are never charged.
faq.q2: Will I receive or pay real money?
faq.a2: No. No payment method is connected. The invoices, balances and payouts you see are simulated and are marked as such in the system.
faq.a3: No. Your account is marked [TESTE] and is invisible to the public — only other testers can see you. That is enforced in the database, not just on screen.
faq.a4: Access expires automatically and the account is deactivated. Content created during the test does not carry over to a real account.
faq.q5: Do I need to sign anything?
faq.a5: You accept the rules on this page by ticking the boxes before you submit — and you can add a signature with your finger if you like. There is no separate contract afterwards.
faq.q6: How much time will this take?
faq.a6: Whatever you can give. We ask that you use the platform as you actually would, and tell us what breaks or confuses you.

pilot.lede: We are opening {{count}} places for professionals to test the full platform for 60 days. No cost and no real payments — the point is to find the problems before your clients do.
